scope: Actual Main startup, Choice scene and manual rig, unavailable native dependencies/failing executable/invalid NetMQ endpoint, warning evidence, honest recorder state and complete VR stop. No physical camera or acquisition. Includes actual GPU sentinel pixels/RenderTexture ownership and post-Main sceneLoaded camera-disable checks for the startup clear.

rootCauses.cause: Optional companion prepare/launch failures aborted the iterator before VR Start; GUI agent owns warning-and-continue handling.
Generic configFile traversal incorrectly required native tracker calibration as an experiment dependency. System tracker subtree now uses dedicated optional, ownership-verified native provenance.
HUD reread the system document with default experiment role, recreating the required-native dependency after Start. It now explicitly uses system role.
Worker endpoint errors logged a fatal-looking Error and finally replaced error state with stopped. Error cause/state now persist and the main-thread run receives a nonblocking warning.

Startup clear used an enabled temporary full-screen camera plus a GL.Clear against an uncontrolled active render target. Root fix disables the camera before manual Render, targets the screen, restores RenderTexture.active in finally and removes the redundant GL.Clear.

requiredDependencies: Required experiment, external-model and skybox files remain strict; optional tracker failures do not silently rewrite configuration or claim acquired input/video.
